task: Build the current connector-bound context for a Simpro-owned US rewrite titled Best Field Service Management Software: 2026 Buyer's Guide to 12 Tools.

scope.title: Best Field Service Management Software: 2026 Buyer's Guide to 12 Tools
scope.audience: US growth-minded trade-business owners, operations leaders, finance and IT buyers, schedulers, administrators, and field users
scope.objective: Help US trade and field-service leaders build a fast, defensible 12-tool shortlist by business type, operating fit, workflow depth, implementation risk, and role needs.
voice_requirements: current Simpro blog voice and tone
competitive_shortlist_requirements: use current official vendor sources before public claims
use exactly Simpro, Jobber, Joblogic, FieldEdge, BuildOps, ServiceTitan, FieldPulse, Housecall Pro, Service Fusion, ServiceM8, Tradify, and Fergus
treat the shortlist as a user-directed scope, not a ranking or claim of universal superiority
use Hindsight internal strategy only to prioritize demo-test emphasis and buyer objections; never use it as public claim support
independently verify every publishable competitor fact against current official vendor documentation
add a five-route best-by-business-type decision surface using start-with language rather than universal-best claims
remove AroFlo, BigChange, Workiz, Field Promax, Arrivy, Skedulo, and Lark Suite without making negative status or quality claims
product_language_requirements: current Simpro field service management platform positioning
feature details require relevant source or approved claim evidence
internal_link_ownership: The exact anchor field service management software in the first public paragraph must link to https://www.simprogroup.com/.
The homepage owns the exact category term; this blog supports the homepage.
This user-authorized override replaces the planned FSM solution-page link and preserves the five-link target.
scope.public_proof_boundary: No public proof claim is proposed in this context request. Before drafting any proof-sensitive product, feature, pricing, customer, competitor, ranking, rating, quote, metric, or availability statement, retrieve approved claims for that exact proposed use.
